items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember Red Happy...? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah, at Larry Theater, yeah. Wonderful. He was one of them.

ctx.x: I didn't know you were, you played in the Eureka.

Yes. As Red, Red was playing trombone at that time. Willie Wilson was leading the band. In other words, that was his band, and Johnny Wilson. Johnny Wilson played the baritone. And I went into the band, and after he, and Shots, excuse me.
I remember Shots was in the Eureka band too.
